name: Range day: fade a break of yesterday's extreme back into the range — mean-reverting tape only (acr 1–5 min)
why: On quiet days (small prior range, small range so far) no large participant needs to push through yesterday's extreme; breaks are probes for stops, and responsive traders take them back into the range. Tape filter pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_tape_filter_all.md).

scan.when: (prng < r*atr && (hod - lod) < q*atr && (px > ph || px < pl)) && acr(rt, 30) < 0
